scene.object: Exact195mm specified pen profile; analytic9mm barrel and10 Blender frusta, max11.2mm diameter; mass22g, I=[2.2e-7,7.3e-5,7.3e-5]

reference.retargeting: Sequential joint-limited least squares: human image-supported fingertip geometry, explicit pair-to-pen proximity/opposition, fixed wrist frame mapping, speed-bounded regularization. This is only a reference and base controller, not the learned policy.
reference.native_mesh_refinement: Native convex-mesh IK with correctly disjoint anatomical finger groups, inactive-finger clearance, three candidate refreshes and speed bounds. Original recorded reconstruction3, fixed30mm morphology extension retained.
reference.use: Object position/directed axis, wrist pose, finger pose and contact-phase reward/reference resets; PPO residual base reference is not the learned result
reference.limitations: Human-depth and contact uncertainty remain; robot reference is offline IK, not dynamically feasible ground truth
reference.preload: Offline native contact-point Jacobian transpose inward force prior; joint target delta=J^T F/kp. Object not actuated. Reset pose stays collision-refined reference, command has small inward preload.

optimized_base_controller.method: Offline reference controller through legal physical dynamics; no RL, no execution-time planner. Base targets baked once. Reference wrist/object targets are kept unchanged. Nonzero training reset states use this physical rollout where available, never during evaluation.

hold_command_extension.method: Freeze final optimized finger targets, retain constant wrist residual through reconstructed wrist motion; blend to original base before next turn. Fixed offline command prior, no object state feedback.

reference.goal_separation: wrist_position/wrist_quat and object_position/object_quat/object_axis remain the human reconstruction3 retargeted by the previously fixed sim2 anatomical mount mapping. q is the offline optimized PD position command; geometric_q is the original collision-refined geometric pose. wrist_command_position/quaternion are optimized base commands, never the wrist-verification reference.
reference.physical_reset_states: Only nonzero training reset phases through1.10s use measured free-physics initial-grasp states. Later phases use corrected native geometric retargeting and reference velocities. Evaluation starts at original nominal frame0 with zero velocity; no mid-episode object state updates.

wrist.type: freejoint; no workspace bounds or pose constraint
wrist.controller: Exact wrist-1 impedance at1kHz: F=2000e_p+60(v*-v)+M*g_up, T=20e_R+.4(omega*-omega)+(c-p)cross M*g_up
wrist.target_update: 500Hz, two controller ticks; pose slewing and matching finite-difference feed-forward; wrench converted from wrist origin to root COM; held object weight not compensated
wrist.base_reference_commands: Reconstructed wrist target only, through wrist-1 target slew limits. Initial-grasp CEM has zero wrist residual. Criterion reference remains reconstructed anatomical mapping, no per-rollout fit.

fingers.controller: Native general actuators implement exact kp(q_target-q)-kd*qd with effort saturation; no torque-speed envelope
fingers.limits: Exact native joint limits, gains, armatures and effort saturation. Actual position/speed/effort checked every1kHz. Violations terminate training; verification continues without resets to report full failures.
fingers.encoder_noise: 500Hz independent Gaussian: position .002rad, velocity .05rad/s; only actor observation affected
fingers.tactile: none; reference sites are geometry markers, not observations
fingers.base_reference_commands: Correctly labelled native geometric reference plus0.35N/finger PD preload. Offline CEM adds index/middle command offsets overinitial hold, tapering to original command by1.17s. No optimized turn script. All commands pass native saturated joint PD.

initial_conditions.reason: Corrected anatomical native retargeting of reconstruction frame0. Same nominal wrist/object placement; independent initial-finger PD preload and initial-hold command prior. Evaluation perturbations remain fixed.
initial_conditions.velocities: zero for full initial-phase episodes; inferred minimum-twist reference velocities for nonzero training reset phases
initial_conditions.randomization: uniform pen position±2mm, rotation±2deg peraxis, joint positions±.01rad within limits; encoder noise always enabled
initial_conditions.training_reset_pool: 180/180 phase starts legal after50ms; physical prefix states where available; prefix-only curricula may further restrict sampled phases

episode.training_terminations: hardware/nonfinite, pen>15cm from reference, floor contact, administrative curriculum horizon or end6.5s
episode.verification: Fixed criteria1, full6.5s initial-phase episodes with no resets; all failure flags retained

validation.controllers: 1kHz exact wrist-1 impedance and saturated joint PD; 500Hz target updates; rigid free pen; no object actuation
validation.limitations: Reference still has uncertainty; offline retargeting is not a policy. Floating-point/contact divergence is expected over long rollouts; verification will use the actual GPU physics states and render those trajectories.

baseline.controller: Corrected anatomical reference plus optimized initial-grasp-only time-indexed PD commands; no PPO or object assistance

body.text: New ablation PPO33 uses corrected warm-reset progress and ordered scheduled pair forces with original small opposition term, removing exclusive/opposed-grasp override and nonpair-release shaping. Criteria1 never required exclusive contact or opposed pair resultants. PPO22 retains pen with zero hardware faults in some full rollouts but drops near3.3s; hypothesis broader wrist adjustment and direct task reward can transfer load to RP rather than solve an unnecessarily restrictive first receiving grasp. Rate terms scale10, actorlr1e-4 with per-minibatch KL0.02, frozen13 to1.75, same native physics and fixed verification. Queued GPU1 after26 evaluation.

Added supplementary diagnostics promised in criteria1: joint RMS versus geometric retarget and command references, object-path RMS/p95, object-axis RMS, and signed axial-spin integral from pen body-frame angular velocity. These do not affect any pass predicate. Regression on retained13 seed202600 raw trajectory reproduces all six criterion flags, milestones, prefix validity, first hardware violation, directed angle and drawdown exactly. Axial spin is separate from task clockwise azimuth and cannot be matched to unobservable demonstration axial roll. Full criteria1 thresholds unchanged.

body.text: Parallel offline second-turn CEM search over two15-dimensional residual knots at2.65/3.0s on frozen recorded PPO22. Start from continuous physical phase0 prefix to2.35s, four fixed perturbed replicas with shared noisyencoders, verify initialIM and firstMR completion before search. Candidate score uses RP contact and360deg completion within2.68..3.18, no exclusive/opposed contact requirement. Native1kHz hardware and contact checks retained; no object forces/state resets after prefix. This is offline reference analysis, not PPO or execution-time planning; no candidate claimed successful before full verification.

Action-range audit: position target is qref plus clipped residual times joint_scale. With0.9rad, a reference PIP near1.5rad cannot request below0.6rad, even though native joint range admits straighter poses. This is a controller hypothesis, not proof criteria are infeasible. Offline second-turn search restarted with1.8rad range, old PPO22 raw actions clipped then physically rescaled so its prefix remains equivalent. Queued PPO34/35/36 widen plain actor ranges to1.8rad, preserving source13 first1.75s; head rescaling matches unsaturated means while intentionally expanding later reachability. No hardware limits/gains or verification thresholds changed; train stops05:37 and hard research stop05:52.

scene.robot: Original right Wuji2.2 URDF link inertias, masses, origins, joint axes and original STL collision meshes; MuJoCo convex hull contact representation
scene.object: Exact195mm specified pen profile; analytic9mm barrel and10 Blender frusta, max11.2mm diameter; mass22g, I=[2.2e-7,7.3e-5,7.3e-5]
scene.object_actuation: none; free rigid body, no welds or force assistance

vendor_contact_exclusions.method: Copy only vendor contact exclusion pairs; preserve task-specific hardware limits, gains, armatures, masses and object.

reference.retargeting: Sequential joint-limited least squares: human image-supported fingertip geometry, explicit pair-to-pen proximity/opposition, fixed wrist frame mapping, speed-bounded regularization. This is only a reference and base controller, not the learned policy.
reference.native_mesh_refinement: Offline mesh-distance IK with inactive fingers extended/spread, three candidate refreshes, speed-bounded sequential solve. Some later reference phases still geometrically infeasible: reference used as guidance only. Initial pose worst self overlap0.253mm; untrained execution has no hardware violations before drop.
reference.use: Object position/directed axis, wrist pose, finger pose and contact-phase reward/reference resets; PPO residual base reference is not the learned result
reference.limitations: Human-depth and contact uncertainty remain; robot reference is offline IK, not dynamically feasible ground truth
reference.preload: Offline native contact-point Jacobian transpose inward force prior; joint target delta=J^T F/kp. Object not actuated. Reset pose stays collision-refined reference, command has small inward preload.

optimized_base_controller.method: Frozen recorded deployable PPO22 (r0130/r0131), itself including frozenPPO13, plus fixed two-knot offlineCEM residual; no online planning. New trainable residual starts2.9s, initiallyzero. Base frozen networks remain in final network; all reinforcement learning was PPO.
optimized_base_controller.reproduction: NPZ __meta__ gives exact args, obs_dim and nested prefix_config. Instantiate ActorCritic with native scene and load all nonmetadata arrays as torch state_dict. Baseline has zero outer residual; final policy must have PPO-trained outer residual and recorded evaluation.

reference.goal_separation: wrist_position/wrist_quat and object_position/object_quat/object_axis remain the human reconstruction3 retargeted by the previously fixed sim2 anatomical mount mapping. q is the offline optimized PD position command; geometric_q is the original collision-refined geometric pose. wrist_command_position/quaternion are optimized base commands, never the wrist-verification reference.

physical_reset_states.method: Physical frozen PPO22 plus fixed offline second-turn residual; source training seeds827..846 disjoint from verification202600..202619
physical_reset_states.initial_perturbations: Same prescribed ranges; this is a training reference, never an evaluation reset
physical_reset_states.physical_validity: No prior hardware/overflow/floor fault, horizontal projection>=.25, drawdown<=75deg, cumulative thumb/palm fraction<5% at each sampled state
physical_reset_states.progress_memory: Exact completed stages and partial80ms contact run from teacher history; no fresh artificial deadline requirement
physical_reset_states.limitation: Future base controller has thumb contact/backward motion and fails full task; only admissible prefix states sampled. Perturbing a reset may break its grasp and is handled by dynamics.

body.text: Parameter study: the public cube specification leaves viscous turning resistance unspecified. Our uniform ball-joint damping0.0015 Nms/rad gives collective layer damping4b=0.006 Nms/rad. The layer inertia is about1.24008e-5 kgm² and detent stiffness0.02 Nm/rad, so this is about6 times held-layer critical damping. At3.14rad/s it consumes18.8mNm before dry friction. I will test0.0003 per ball (collective0.0012,about1.2 times critical), with the same mass,geometry,elastic interlock,15degree break rule,dry-friction evaluation range and hand hardware. This is an explicit alternative nominal model for an unspecified parameter,not a verification threshold change. Revalidate snap/stay,elastic recovery,all-axis turns and held grasp before training;report the physical-model limitation.

body.text: Asymmetric PPO method: train a separate critic on private cube/contact state,while the actor branch reads only102deployable scalars. Unit tests show zero private-input gradients and exact actor invariance, and the exported102-input actor contains no critic. To keep record labels conservative, these training iterations will be taggedprivileged;the eventual reported policy will receive a further PPO stage with public actor and public critic before final verification. This follows LEARNING.md allowance for privileged training/teachers followed by deployable PPO. No private data enters the execution actor;no execution-time planner is used. Implementation follows the separate actor/value network interface in https://stable-baselines3.readthedocs.io/en/master/guide/custom_policy.html .

Velocity-frame audit found a hardware-model error: mj_objectVelocity with mjOBJ_BODY returns linear velocity at the link COM,not the wrist-frame origin. A1rad/s pure rotation gives17mm/s COM velocity while the wrist origin is stationary;XBODY matches the finite-difference origin velocity exactly. Correct wrist feedback and cube root-state/verification velocities toXBODY in new sim11. Earlier failed experiments remain failures and are not eligible evidence of exact specified actuator fidelity. Stop older training,retain checkpoints,then continue the most promising absolute-target/asymmetric PPO run in the corrected model. Source confirms body-inertial versusbody-regular behavior: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/main/src/engine/engine_core_util.c . No hardware limit or verification threshold is changed.

Reverse-curriculum observability: earlier partial starts rotated the opposite layer while keeping cubie0 root orientation fixed,so the actor’s allowed object-state frame did not reveal partial progress. For sim11 training resets,turn the layer containing cubie0:postmultiply root orientation by+theta and rotate the opposite four cubies by-theta relative to it. This is the same legal relative configuration,with visible root progress. Fit collision-compatible finger grasps again. Add a small0.1 root-relative-orientation term inside the existing task-progress potential to prefer this observable physical strategy,while legal cubie configuration still gates every milestone. Full-evaluation initial state and criteria are unchanged. No part state is added to actor inputs;the public root frame is exactly that specified in object/SPECS.md.

Simulation12 records later-turn collision-aware reset banks,120short trials without hardware/break/floor failure,unchanged final evaluation starts,and exact v11 trajectory regression. Later-turn reset progress is evaluator/training-only and never an actor feature. Preparing a public-observation actor-and-critic PPO continuation by copying only the PPO teacher actor and its public normalization;the final verified checkpoint will include this PPO stage. Criteria1 unchanged;no fulltask PASS.

The bank-to-original-grasp domain gap is under direct PPO adaptation in11b. A diagnostic replacing the nominal start by exact-zero bank grasp had2hardware violations in30design trials at full reset perturbations,so it is rejected rather than used for evaluation. Start a second-turn PPO branch in recorded sim12 from matching checkpoint2132240 andnormalization,16environments,75–88degree secondturn resets,20%full-original-start rehearsal,seed1799. First-turn full-start adaptation continues independently;no inference-time planning,object assistance,or changedcriteria. If branches specialize,allowed PPO-teacher distillation followed bypublic-observation PPO can combine their actors.

Use concurrent PPO skill teachers within the remaining3h44m:thirdturn branch iter13 in simulation12,start_progress2,16environments,75–88degree reverse curriculum,20%fullstartrehearsal,seed1899,90min cap. It shares matching firstturn PPO checkpoint2132240 withiter12,not a scripted solving reference. Learned subskills may be distilled using training-onlyphase labels into one public actor,then PPO-finetuned from fullstart;all final tests still requirethreeactuallegalmoves fromoriginalscramble. Partial-start goals never count as task verification passes.

Negative transfer diagnosed in later-turn teachers:afterroughly5minutes,the inherited firstturn actor stillhas0%secure secondturn success. In a separate design-seed25000diagnostic,zero residual already securely completes partialsecondturns at80/85/88degrees andthirdturns at80/85/88,without hardware violations;the inherited actor destroys these easy starts. Restart later-turn PPO action heads at zero,retain learned features/critic but clearoptimizer state,setinitialfingerstdexp(-1.5) andwriststdexp(-2.5),and removeoriginal-start rehearsal in these specializedteachers. Thefirstteacher separatelylearnsfullstart;combinationwilluseBCfromPPOteachersfollowedbypublicPPO. No physics,initialfull-evaluationstates,orcriteriachanges.

scene.robot: Exact left URDF link masses,inertial tensors,joint axes,limits and collision mesh geometry. cube_mechanism.method: Passive internal torques only. All three axes and both face directions permitted. Alignment unlock determined by actual elastic deflection,not task goal. Off-manifold spring0.5Nm/rad,ball joint implicit damping0.0003Nms/rad,dry turning resistance0.0015Nm,20degree detent zone with0.02Nm/rad stiffness. Beyond20degrees released stays. limitations: Human individual layer turns, scramble, and cubie0 identity cannot be recovered reliably from this monocular demonstration.
The custom passive cube interlock and contact parameters are simulation hypotheses requiring physical validation.
Monocular absolute depth uncertainty is approximately68mm; registered relative paths and robot morphology corrections remain modeling assumptions.
The fixed30 verification seeds were reused during iterative diagnosis and model selection; this is self-verification, not independent held-out generalization.
Full-task solve, human-like tracking, contact continuity, release, and hardware compliance must all pass together; isolated partial-start successes do not establish reproduction.
body.audit_correction: The independent checker integer-target truncation defect was fixed and saved trajectories re-audited. Original published evidence is preserved. Restore the final evaluator patch after an older checkpoint bundle. No physics/policy/criteria changes; full task verdict unchanged.
body.candidate_selection_method: Select among public full30-seed evaluations by more complete task successes, then lexicographic counts reaching at least3/2/1 legal goals without hardware/break/independent-audit violations, then fewer hardware-failure episodes, then more wrist/path and contact criterion passes. This selects an incomplete candidate if all fail; it is not an official score and never changes the criteria verdict.
body.own_claim_only: This is self-verification in a custom simulation, not an official evaluation, score, ranking, or real-robot result.
body.scope: One fixed known nontrivial three-face-move scramble, with30fixed randomized trials. Human exact scramble and layer trajectory are unobservable.

baseline.equivalence: Versions20 through23 share the same original-start physical model and zero-action controller; reward changes do not alter rollouts, and training boundary replay is disabled in evaluation. Baseline21 therefore uses identical physical dynamics and controller for the selected candidate.

body.verdict_explanation: The complete task was not reproduced under the frozen criteria. Legal-goal progress and partial-start training do not count as complete task success.

body.text:
Final reflection for the 8-hour stop. Started 2026-11-05 20:19:58 UTC; hard stop 2026-11-06 04:19:58 UTC. Final self-verification r0163 is FAIL: 0/30 complete tasks. The selected public PPO policy completes one legal first turn in 15/30 trials; four other trials violate hardware limits. No eligible public policy completes a second legal goal in full original-start verification. Wrist/cube tracking and solved release remain unsatisfied.

What worked: a VALID whole-cube and wrist reconstruction with explicit limits on unobservable layer turns and scramble; a free-wrist left-hand simulation with specified controllers and a passive cube; and PPO learning a first turn beyond the zero-residual baseline, which makes no turns or solves and has no hardware failures. Correcting the wrist velocity frame and freezing public observation normalization resolved major fidelity and policy-function errors.

What failed: composing later-turn partial-start skills into actual handoffs, transferring to full wrist motion and randomization, and balancing tracking costs against early failure. The independent checker's integer-matrix truncation defect was fixed; 17 saved public evaluations were re-audited, preserving original evidence. Legal synthetic tests and an illegal 40-degree corner control validate the correction. Complete-task verdicts remain FAIL.

Next I would train longer with a contact-secured recovery curriculum reached on policy, recurrent PPO using only public observations, longer credit assignment, and physically calibrated contact/interlock parameters. This is a single known-scramble simulation study, not an official evaluation or a real-robot result. Every evaluated iteration, final trajectories, checkpoint, training curves and three-view rollout evidence is preserved. All research training and evaluation processes have stopped.
